--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,126 @@
+import pytest
+from orders import checkout
+
+def test_checkout_success():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 3
+    result = checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert result == 15
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 7
+
+def test_checkout_exhaustion():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 5}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 2}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 5
+    result = checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert result == 10
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 0
+
+def test_checkout_zero_quantity_raises_valueerror():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 0
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 10
+
+def test_checkout_negative_quantity_raises_valueerror():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = -3
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 10
+
+def test_checkout_insufficient_stock_raises_valueerror():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 5}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 2}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 7
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 5
+
+def test_checkout_missing_sku_in_stock_raises_keyerror():
+    stock = {'sku_b': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_c'
+    quantity = 1
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_b'] == 10
+
+def test_checkout_missing_sku_in_prices_raises_keyerror():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_b': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_c'
+    quantity = 1
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 10
+
+def test_checkout_prices_unchanged_after_success():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 3
+    result = checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert prices['sku_a'] == 5
+
+def test_checkout_prices_unchanged_after_failure():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_b'
+    quantity = 1
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert prices['sku_a'] == 5
+
+def test_checkout_stock_unchanged_after_failure():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 5}
+    sku = 'sku_b'
+    quantity = 1
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 10
+
+def test_checkout_multiple_quantities_independent():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 3}
+    # First transaction reduces stock by 2
+    result1 = checkout(stock, prices, 'sku_a', 2)
+    assert result1 == 6
+    # Second transaction should use remaining stock
+    result2 = checkout(stock, prices, 'sku_a', 4)
+    assert result2 == 12
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 4
+
+def test_checkout_unrelated_skus_independent():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 5, 'sku_b': 3}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 2, 'sku_b': 4}
+    # First checkout sku_a only
+    result1 = checkout(stock, prices, 'sku_a', 2)
+    assert result1 == 4
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 3
+    assert stock['sku_b'] == 3
+    # Second checkout sku_b only
+    result2 = checkout(stock, prices, 'sku_b', 3)
+    assert result2 == 12
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 3
+    assert stock['sku_b'] == 0
+
+def test_checkout_multiple_products_in_one_transaction():
+    stock = {'sku_a': 10, 'sku_b': 5}
+    prices = {'sku_a': 2, 'sku_b': 4}
+    sku = 'sku_a'
+    quantity = 3
+    result = checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity)
+    assert result == 6
+    assert stock['sku_a'] == 7
+    assert stock['sku_b'] == 5
